exposure: Mental health during pregnancy (depressive and anxiety symptoms)
finding: Depressive and anxiety symptoms, pregnancy complications, and poorer subjective birth experience predicted PTSD symptoms in both mothers and fathers, while lower support during birth and unplanned cesarean section were specific predictors for mothers, and lower job satisfaction, higher job burden, being a first-time father, lower education, and lower partner support during birth were specific predictors for fathers.
mod_finding: An unplanned cesarean section was a predictor of PTSD symptoms in mothers.
